SURESHWAR THAKUR, J. (ORAL)
1. Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks, and, is permitted to withdraw the instant writ petition,
as the return of the subject land, becomes anchored, upon the envisagings made in Section 101-A of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as became engrafted through the Haryana Amending Act 21 of 2018 (amended through notification dated 24.05.2018), envisaging(s) whereof, however has been quashed and set aside vide decision rendered by this Court in CWP-11498-2019.
